description: Source code implementing a workaround for integer power expressions in shader compilation, specifically targeting a bug in HLSL. It traverses an abstract syntax tree to identify and replace problematic pow operations with alternative computations.

classes.name: Traverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to find and replace specific pow operations.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Static method to apply the traversal and transformation on the AST.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes to identify problematic pow operations.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Prepares the traverser for the next traversal iteration.
